notes: Tail case: U1/U2 refs named whole persons and wrong sides; now name the garments (masks are already the garments). U3 ref gave the wrong side. U4 (green cap) was on the same man as U2, so it was retargeted to the gray tree stump in the meadow with a new SAM3 mask.

spec.ref: the open brown plaid shirt of the man in the Black Sabbath T-shirt

units.ref_zh: 穿Black Sabbath T恤男子敞开的棕色格子衬衫
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将穿Black Sabbath T恤男子敞开的棕色格子衬衫的颜色改为海军蓝。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域的颜色改为海军蓝。
units.reason: Mask is the open plaid overshirt (T-shirt excluded) of the man right of center; ref now names the garment and its owner, not a person 'at the left'.

spec.ref: the navy graphic T-shirt of the man in the green cap at the front right

units.ref_zh: 右前方戴绿色鸭舌帽男子的海军蓝印花T恤
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将右前方戴绿色鸭舌帽男子的海军蓝印花T恤替换为一件黄色连帽雨衣。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域替换为一件黄色连帽雨衣。
units.reason: Person was replaced by clothing; the mask is the T-shirt (backpack straps excluded), so the T-shirt is replaced by a different garment.

spec.ref: the white plastic bag with a green logo carried by the woman holding a phone to her face

units.ref_zh: 把手机贴在脸边的女子拎着的带绿色标志的白色塑料袋
units.instruction_ref_zh: 移除把手机贴在脸边的女子拎着的带绿色标志的白色塑料袋。
units.reason: Bag is right of center (0.65W), carried by the dark-haired woman in a light blouse holding a phone to her face; 'near the left' was wrong and fit other bags.

spec.ref: the large upright gray tree stump in the meadow behind the walkers

units.ref_zh: 人群后方草地上直立的灰色大树桩
units.instruction_ref_zh: 在人群后方草地上直立的灰色大树桩上加上一只黑色乌鸦。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 在选中区域上加上一只黑色乌鸦。
preserve: 保留人物服装、随身物品和草地场景。
units.reason: Retarget: the green cap belonged to the same man as U2. New independent target is the dead tree stump in the field (SAM3 mask, verified); payload made specific.
